summary: This document is a project metadata/tracking record for Challenge A1, targeting human EGFR extracellular domain (UniProt P00533). It describes a computational prediction run (not a measured binding affinity/KD), with a noted protocol deviation (PDB 1IVO used instead of admitted 8HGO). The document primarily serves as an OpenLabs project index with associated URLs and identifiers, with no experimental binding data reported.

content_blocks.title: Challenge A1 — Project Metadata & Status
content_blocks.content: Challenge: A1. Target: human EGFR ECD (UniProt P00533). PDB admitted: 8HGO / chain A. PDB actually run: 1IVO / chain A — flagged as a protocol_deviation. Status: computational prediction only; NOT a measured KD or confirmed binder. Spend: $6.05 USD (BIOS staging MCP). This indicates the work is at TRL 1–2: a computational/in silico prediction with no experimental binding validation.

content_blocks.title: Workflow & File Management Note
content_blocks.content: Operational note: OpenLabs is used for claims/discussions; Molecule Labs is the file vault. Instructions specify not to replace OpenLabs posts with vault uploads — Lab links should be commented under matching posts after upload. This is a process/governance note with no direct TRL-relevant experimental content.

key_findings: Target is human EGFR extracellular domain (ECD), UniProt P00533 — a well-validated oncology target.
Work is a computational prediction only; no KD or experimental binding measurement has been performed.
Protocol deviation noted: PDB structure 1IVO / chain A was used instead of the admitted structure 8HGO / chain A.
Total compute/platform spend was $6.05 USD via BIOS staging MCP, indicating a very early-stage, low-cost in silico exercise.
Project is classified as 'not a measured binder' — TRL 1 (basic principles/concept) at best.
Project is tracked on the OpenLabs platform under the Mini-swarm A-series project.
